title: Cybersecurity Strategy
description: Financial institutions shall maintain an approved cybersecurity strategy aligned with business objectives

title: Cybersecurity Risk Assessment
description: Cybersecurity risks shall be identified assessed treated and monitored using a formal methodology

title: Access Rights Management
description: Access rights shall be granted based on business need least privilege and segregation of duties

title: Customer Data Protection
description: Customer and financial information shall be protected against unauthorized disclosure alteration and loss

title: Security Monitoring
description: Security logs and relevant events shall be monitored to identify suspicious or unauthorized activity

title: Regulatory Incident Notification
description: Significant cybersecurity incidents shall be escalated and reported to the competent financial regulator as required

title: Outsourcing Security
description: Third-party and outsourcing arrangements shall include cybersecurity requirements and assurance obligations

title: Cyber Resilience
description: Recovery capabilities shall be maintained and tested for critical financial services

title: Secure Change Control
description: Changes to production systems shall be authorized tested and documented before implementation

title: Vulnerability Management Process
description: Vulnerabilities shall be assessed prioritized remediated and monitored

title: Cloud Risk Management
description: Cloud services shall be assessed for regulatory data protection and outsourcing requirements before use

title: Technology Asset Management
description: Technology assets shall be inventoried classified and assigned accountable ownership
